collectionMemo.title: Collection memo
collectionMemo.description: Record the date ranges you have collected for each target. All timelines share the configured start and end at the current time.
collectionMemo.target.label: Collection target
collectionMemo.range.localTime: Without a time zone, your local zone ({{zone}}) is used. Add Z or an offset such as +08:00 to specify a zone.
collectionMemo.range.parseHint: Type or paste a date and time to check the interpreted result here.
collectionMemo.range.dateOnlyHint: A date without a time means local midnight on that date.
collectionMemo.range.pointHint: Use the same start and end time to record a single collected point.
collectionMemo.range.empty: No collected ranges recorded for this target.
collectionMemo.timeline.label: Collection timeline for {{name}}
collectionMemo.timeline.fillGap: Collected this range, merge adjacent ranges
collectionMemo.timeline.resizeHint: Drag a boundary and release to save; press Esc to cancel. Arrow keys adjust by a minute, Shift by an hour, and Home / End move to the allowed limits.
collectionMemo.timeline.saveFailed: Could not save this timeline change. Please try again.
collectionMemo.timeline.changed: These records changed. The operation was cancelled. Try again using the updated records.
collectionMemo.confirm.deleteTarget: Delete “{{name}}” and all its collected ranges?
collectionMemo.validation.name: Enter a collection target name of 1 to 200 characters.
collectionMemo.validation.date: Enter a valid date and time, such as 2026-09-05 16:00. Check that the date and time exist.
collectionMemo.validation.order: The end must be at or after the start.
collectionMemo.validation.future: Collected dates and times cannot be in the future.
collectionMemo.error.load: Could not load collection memos. Refresh to try again.
collectionMemo.error.save: Could not save your changes. Check the details and try again.
collectionMemo.empty: Add a collection target to start recording your collected ranges.
collectionMemo.noResults: No collection targets match your search.
collectionMemo.browsingIntegration.pendi: Visited-post integration is pending. Nearby visited posts do not prove that every post between them was collected. A future integration could suggest individual points and let you confirm complete ranges.
collectionMemo.settings.title: Timeline settings
collectionMemo.settings.reverse: Current time on the left, start on the right
collectionMemo.settings.forward: Start on the left, current time on the right
collectionMemo.settings.description: These settings are saved and apply to every collection target. A global start is required and cannot be in the future.
collectionMemo.settings.inheritHint: Blank range starts follow changes to the global start. Explicit starts are kept; portions earlier than the global start are outside the visible timeline.
collectionMemo.settings.future: The global start cannot be in the future.
collectionMemo.settings.inheritedOrder: The global start cannot be later than the end of any range that inherits it. Adjust those ranges first.
collectionMemo.range.inheritPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the global start
collectionMemo.range.inheritHint: A blank start uses the global start and follows changes to timeline settings. Enter a date to keep this range’s start fixed.
collectionMemo.validation.inheritedOrder: The end cannot be before the global start. Change the end or enter an earlier start.
collectionMemo.range.urlHint: Click the time range to open this link in your browser.
collectionMemo.validation.url: Enter a full http:// or https:// link.
collectionMemo.timeline.linksHint: Press Enter to choose a link for this time range.
